name: Penciljam Bengaluru at Rangoli Metro Art Center
description:
Developed by BMRCL after the construction of the Namma Metro, the center opened in 2013 on the restored MG Road boulevard, bringing galleries, performance spaces, workshops and public art into the everyday life of the city.
Themed Jam
We will be drawing portraits of each other and of jammers holding poses. If you enjoy drawing people and portraits join in.
How to join this session
You don't need artistic skill to participate in this event - just boundless curiosity and a love for drawing. To connect with other participants, please use our community on Discord.

If this is your first time and would like future update on events, and more. Please register here.

Once you arrive at the location, find your way to the snakes and ladder game to find others.
Things to carry for this session

 	A sketchbook/paper/drawing surface
 	Any medium you would like to use/learn/try.
 	A portable chair/mat. If the location has no seating, we tend to sit on the ground
 	Water bottle and snacks

How to get there
Follow the location map provided
Closest metro station: MG road
